heading: Your Profile
disclaimer: This is a prototype account page backed by a mock sign-in — nothing here is a real BIS-issued identity or credential.

identity.heading: Identity
identity.body: Set once at sign-in by this prototype's mock session — there's no edit form here because nothing in this demo actually updates it.

preferences.heading: Preferences
preferences.body: How SAATHI addresses you and sounds while you chat — saved on this device only.

sms.heading: SMS Notifications
sms.intro: This prototype has no SMS provider and no phone number on your account, so these are non-functional toggles scaffolding a future integration — not a working feature.

renewalAlerts.label: Renewal & expiry alerts
renewalAlerts.description: An SMS reminder before a certification or licence renewal is due.

criticalStatusChanges.label: Critical status changes
criticalStatusChanges.description: An SMS when an application or payment status changes critically (e.g. rejected, overdue).

sms.unavailableNote: Not available in this prototype — requires backend SMS integration.

account.heading: Account & Access
account.body: Your current role and where to find the rest of your work.

activity.heading: Recent Activity
activity.body: Sourced from your active applications — the same feed your dashboard shows.
